use default

factorial(value: int) -> bigint is
    let product mut = 1n

    for factor in 2::value do
        product = product * cast(factor)
    od

    return product

nth_prime(index: int) -> int is
    let found mut = 0
    let candidate mut = 1

    while found <= index do
        candidate = candidate + 1
        let divisor mut = 2

        while divisor * divisor <= candidate /\ candidate % divisor != 0 do
            divisor = divisor + 1
        od

        if divisor * divisor > candidate then
            found = found + 1
        fi
    od

    return candidate
si

fibonacci(index: int) -> bigint is
    let previous mut = 0n
    let current mut = 1n

    for _ in 0..index do
        let following = previous + current
        previous = current
        current = following
    od

    return current
si

boustrophedon(term: (int) -> bigint, count: int) -> Pipe[bigint] is
    let row mut = LIST()
    row.add(term(0))

    yield row[0]

    for index in 1..count do
        let following = LIST()
        following.add(term(index))

        for step in 1::index do
            following.add(following[step - 1] + row[index - step])
        od

        row = following
        yield row[index]
    od
si

report(name: string, term: (int) -> bigint) is
    let transformed = boustrophedon(term, 15) |> collect_list()
    let texts = LIST()

    for value in transformed do
        texts.add("{value}")
    od

    let stretched = boustrophedon(term, 1_000) |> collect_list()
    let digits = stretched[999].to_string()

    write_line("{name}:")
    write_line("  first 15: {texts |> join(" ")}")
    write_line("  1000th: {digits[0..20]}...{digits[20..<<0]}")
    write_line("          ({digits.length} digits)")
si

report("unit", index =>
    if index == 0 then 1n else 0n fi)
report("ones", _ => 1n)
report("alternating", index => (
    if index % 2 == 0 then 1n
    else 0n - 1n fi))
report("primes", index => cast bigint(nth_prime(index)))
report("fibonacci", index => fibonacci(index))
report("factorials", index => factorial(index))
